import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / 'build/source-phase-profile'
build = root / 'build/jit-prepared-activations'
smart = json.loads((out / 'SMART.json').read_text())
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(build / 'mmay') == smart['baseline_sha256']
revision = smart['parent_revision']
sources = {}
def original(path):
    text = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', revision + ':' + path], text=True)
    assert Path(path).read_text() == text
    sources[path] = sha(path)
    return text
def before(source, marker, phase):
    assert source.count(marker) == 1, marker
    return source.replace(marker, '    phase_set("' + phase + '");\n' + marker)

main = original('bootstrap/main.c')
main = before(main, '    mmay_session_init(&session, mmay_system_allocator());', 'host_setup')
main = before(main, '    mmay_owned_bytes_dispose(&executable_path);', 'host_teardown')
main = main.replace('    return exit_code;', '    phase_dump();\n    return exit_code;')
(out / 'main.c').write_text(main)
run = original('bootstrap/src/cli/cli_run_program.c')
for marker, phase in [
    ('    argument_status = mmay_cli_program_arguments_build(', 'argument_import'),
    ('    target_status = mmay_cli_check_target_build(session, options, &target);', 'source_load'),
    ('    compiler_status = mmay_compiler_service_check_graph(', 'frontend_setup'),
    ('    if (compiler_status != MMAY_COMPILER_OK) {', 'diagnostics'),
    ('    if (!mmay_cli_optimize_checked_mir(&compiler)) {', 'mir_optimize'),
    ('    entry_status = mmay_check_select_entry(', 'entry_select'),
    ('    for (index = 0; index < compiler->checked.functions.length; index += 1) {\n        const MarimayCheckedFunction *function = mmay_checked_function(\n            &compiler->checked, index\n        );\n        if (function != NULL && !function->is_external) function_count += 1;', 'lower_prepare'),
    ('    lower_status = mmay_mir_lower_bytecode_program(', 'bytecode_lower'),
    ('    codec_status = mmay_bytecode_encode_program(', 'bytecode_encode'),
    ('    codec_status = mmay_bytecode_decode_program(', 'bytecode_decode'),
    ('    if (mmay_bytecode_program_verify(&decoded)', 'cli_bytecode_verify'),
    ('    execution_options = mmay_bytecode_execution_default_options();', 'execution_setup'),
    ('    run_status = mmay_bytecode_run_program(\n        &decoded,', 'vm_entry'),
    ('    if (run_status != MMAY_BYTECODE_RUN_OK) {\n        exit_code = mmay_cli_run_runtime_error(', 'result'),
    ('    if (panic_ready) mmay_bytecode_panic_dispose(&panic);', 'cli_vm_teardown'),
    ('    mmay_cli_program_arguments_dispose(&program_arguments);', 'compiler_teardown')]:
    run = before(run, marker, phase)
(out / 'cli_run_program.c').write_text(run)
service = original('bootstrap/src/check/service.c')
for marker, phase in [
    ('        lex_status = mmay_lex_snapshot(', 'lex'),
    ('        failure = mmay_compiler_lex_status(lex_status);', 'frontend_setup'),
    ('        if (document->has_edit && previous_unit != NULL', 'parse'),
    ('        failure = mmay_compiler_parse_status(parse_status);', 'frontend_setup'),
    ('        ast_status = mmay_ast_project(', 'ast_project'),
    ('        failure = mmay_compiler_ast_status(ast_status);', 'frontend_setup'),
    ('    failure = target->is_graph\n        ? mmay_compiler_check_graph_semantics(service, target, built)', 'semantic_check'),
    ('    if (failure == MMAY_COMPILER_OK\n        && mmay_compiler_request_cancelled(request)) {', 'frontend_cleanup')]:
    service = before(service, marker, phase)
(out / 'service.c').write_text(service)
vm = original('bootstrap/src/bytecode/vm.c')
for marker, phase in [
    ('    status = mmay_bytecode_run_program_verify_status(', 'runtime_verify'),
    ('    if (mmay_bytecode_run_program_uses_f64(program)', 'vm_setup'),
    ('        MarimayBytecodeImageStatus image_status =', 'image_prepare'),
    ('            status = mmay_bytecode_jit_init(', 'jit_prepare'),
    ('    if (!mmay_bytecode_run_frames_reserve(', 'vm_setup'),
    ('    current_frame = &stack.frames[0];', 'vm_execute'),
    ('    while (stack.count != 0) {', 'vm_teardown')]:
    vm = before(vm, marker, phase)
(out / 'vm.c').write_text(vm)
flags = {}
for line in (build / 'CMakeFiles/mmay_bootstrap.dir/flags.make').read_text().splitlines():
    if ' = ' in line:
        key, value = line.split(' = ', 1)
        flags[key] = shlex.split(value)
includes = []
for folder in ['bootstrap/src/cli', 'bootstrap/src/bytecode', 'bootstrap/src/check', 'build/source-phase-profile']:
    includes += ['-I', str(root / folder)]
commands, objects = [], []
for name in ['main', 'cli_run_program', 'service', 'vm', 'phase']:
    command = ['/usr/bin/cc'] + flags['C_DEFINES'] + flags['C_INCLUDES'] + includes + flags['C_FLAGS']
    command += ['-include', str(out / 'phase.h'), '-c', str(out / (name + '.c')), '-o', str(out / (name + '.o'))]
    commands.append(command)
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)
    objects.append(str(out / (name + '.o')))
link = shlex.split((build / 'CMakeFiles/mmay.dir/link.txt').read_text())
command = []
for word in link:
    if word == 'CMakeFiles/mmay.dir/bootstrap/main.c.o': command += objects
    elif word == 'mmay': command.append(str(out / 'mmay'))
    elif word.endswith('.a'): command.append(str(build / word))
    else: command.append(word)
commands.append(command)
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
record = {'revision': revision, 'baseline_compiler_sha256': sha(build / 'mmay'),
    'archive_sha256': sha(build / 'libmmay_bootstrap.a'), 'sljit_archive_sha256': sha(build / 'libmmay_sljit.a'), 'profile_compiler_sha256': sha(out / 'mmay'),
    'production_source_sha256': sources, 'instrumented_source_sha256': {p.name: sha(p) for p in out.glob('*.c')},
    'commands': commands}
(out / 'build.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Diagnostic profile binary built; production sources and baseline unchanged.')

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

root = Path.cwd()
base = root / 'build/source-phase-profile'
bench = root.parent / 'algorithm-benchmarks'
ref = root / 'docs/implementation/evidence/cp42-vm-preparation-comprehensive-2026-09-09.json'
reference = json.loads(ref.read_text())
build = json.loads((base / 'build.json').read_text())
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
compilers = {'control': root / 'build/jit-prepared-activations/mmay', 'profile': base / 'mmay'}
assert sha(compilers['control']) == build['baseline_compiler_sha256']
assert sha(compilers['profile']) == build['profile_compiler_sha256']
def verify():
    for p, h in reference['metadata']['source_sha256'].items(): assert sha(bench / p) == h, p
    for p, h in build['production_source_sha256'].items(): assert sha(root / p) == h, p
verify()
result = {'schema': 'marimay.source-phase-profile/1', 'status': 'running',
    'started_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'build': build, 'protocol': json.loads((base / 'SMART.json').read_text()),
    'source_sha256': reference['metadata']['source_sha256'],
    'reference_sha256': sha(ref), 'raw': [], 'summary': {},
    'power': subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'batt'], text=True),
    'thermal': subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'therm'], text=True),
    'limitations': ['Instrumentation changes code layout and records clocks; these are phase diagnostics, not speed acceptance measurements.',
        'Three fresh-process samples per variant, with no benchmark warmup claim. All source-run work remains included.',
        'Host isolation is unverified. CPU time reduces sensitivity to scheduling gaps but is not a substitute for wall-clock performance.',
        'Success-path checkpoints classify adjacent bookkeeping with their phase; encode/decode/lowering can themselves include verification.']}
names = list(reference['workloads'])
assert len(names) == 32
for round_id in range(3):
    order = names[round_id:] + names[:round_id]
    if round_id % 2: order.reverse()
    for index, name in enumerate(order):
        row = reference['workloads'][name]
        labels = ['control', 'profile'] if (index + round_id) % 2 == 0 else ['profile', 'control']
        for label in labels:
            command = list(row['commands']['marimay-vm'])
            source = Path('marimay/benchmarks') / name.replace('-', '_') if row.get('anchor') else Path('marimay/catalog')
            assert Path(command[2]).as_posix().endswith('/' + source.as_posix())
            command[0], command[2] = str(compilers[label]), str(bench / source)
            started = time.perf_counter_ns()
            done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=bench, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
            elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
            assert done.returncode == 0 and done.stdout == row['expected_stdout'], (name, label, done.stdout, done.stderr)
            event = {'round': round_id, 'workload': name, 'variant': label, 'command': command, 'elapsed_ms': elapsed,
                'stdout': done.stdout, 'stderr': done.stderr}
            if label == 'profile':
                assert done.stderr.startswith('PHASE ') and len(done.stderr.splitlines()) == 1
                data = json.loads(done.stderr[6:])
                for unit in ['wall_ms', 'cpu_ms']:
                    assert all(v[unit] >= 0 for v in data['phases'].values())
                    assert abs(sum(v[unit] for v in data['phases'].values()) - data[unit]) < .0001
                assert data['wall_ms'] <= elapsed + .1
                assert data['phases']['vm_execute']['entries'] == 1
                event['profile'] = data
            else: assert done.stderr == '', (name, done.stderr)
            result['raw'].append(event)
            (base / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('Diagnostic paired round', round_id + 1, 'of 3 completed', flush=True)
for name in names:
    records = [e for e in result['raw'] if e['workload'] == name]
    profiles = [e['profile'] for e in records if e['variant'] == 'profile']
    phases = list(profiles[0]['phases'])
    assert all(list(p['phases']) == phases for p in profiles)
    result['summary'][name] = {
        'control_median_ms': statistics.median(e['elapsed_ms'] for e in records if e['variant'] == 'control'),
        'instrumented_median_ms': statistics.median(e['elapsed_ms'] for e in records if e['variant'] == 'profile'),
        'phase_medians': {n: {u: statistics.median(p['phases'][n][u] for p in profiles) for u in ['wall_ms', 'cpu_ms', 'entries']} for n in phases}}
verify()
result['status'] = 'passed'
result['finished_utc'] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
(base / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
for name in ['title-search-10k', 'insertion', 'stack', 'dsu']:
    phases = result['summary'][name]['phase_medians']
    print(name, sorted(((n, round(v['cpu_ms'], 2)) for n,v in phases.items()), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:7], flush=True)

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

root = Path.cwd()
base = root / 'build/source-phase-profile/verification'
bench = root.parent / 'algorithm-benchmarks'
ref = root / 'docs/implementation/evidence/cp42-vm-preparation-comprehensive-2026-09-09.json'
reference = json.loads(ref.read_text())
build = json.loads((base / 'build.json').read_text())
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
compilers = {'control': root / 'build/jit-prepared-activations/mmay', 'profile': base / 'mmay'}
assert sha(compilers['control']) == build['baseline_compiler_sha256']
assert sha(compilers['profile']) == build['profile_compiler_sha256']
def verify():
    for p, h in reference['metadata']['source_sha256'].items(): assert sha(bench / p) == h, p
    for p, h in build['production_source_sha256'].items(): assert sha(root / p) == h, p
verify()
result = {'schema': 'marimay.source-phase-profile/1', 'status': 'running',
    'started_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'build': build, 'protocol': json.loads((base / 'SMART.json').read_text()),
    'source_sha256': reference['metadata']['source_sha256'],
    'reference_sha256': sha(ref), 'raw': [], 'summary': {},
    'power': subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'batt'], text=True),
    'thermal': subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'therm'], text=True),
    'limitations': ['Instrumentation changes code layout and records clocks; these are phase diagnostics, not speed acceptance measurements.',
        'Three fresh-process samples per variant, with no benchmark warmup claim. All source-run work remains included.',
        'Host isolation is unverified. CPU time reduces sensitivity to scheduling gaps but is not a substitute for wall-clock performance.',
        'Success-path checkpoints classify adjacent bookkeeping with their phase; encode/decode/lowering can themselves include verification.']}
names = list(reference['workloads'])
assert len(names) == 32
for round_id in range(3):
    order = names[round_id:] + names[:round_id]
    if round_id % 2: order.reverse()
    for index, name in enumerate(order):
        row = reference['workloads'][name]
        labels = ['control', 'profile'] if (index + round_id) % 2 == 0 else ['profile', 'control']
        for label in labels:
            command = list(row['commands']['marimay-vm'])
            source = Path('marimay/benchmarks') / name.replace('-', '_') if row.get('anchor') else Path('marimay/catalog')
            assert Path(command[2]).as_posix().endswith('/' + source.as_posix())
            command[0], command[2] = str(compilers[label]), str(bench / source)
            started = time.perf_counter_ns()
            done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=bench, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
            elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
            assert done.returncode == 0 and done.stdout == row['expected_stdout'], (name, label, done.stdout, done.stderr)
            event = {'round': round_id, 'workload': name, 'variant': label, 'command': command, 'elapsed_ms': elapsed,
                'stdout': done.stdout, 'stderr': done.stderr}
            if label == 'profile':
                assert done.stderr.startswith('PHASE ') and len(done.stderr.splitlines()) == 1
                data = json.loads(done.stderr[6:])
                for unit in ['wall_ms', 'cpu_ms']:
                    assert all(v[unit] >= 0 for v in data['phases'].values())
                    assert abs(sum(v[unit] for v in data['phases'].values()) - data[unit]) < .0001
                assert data['wall_ms'] <= elapsed + .1
                assert data['phases']['vm_execute']['entries'] == 1
                event['profile'] = data
            else: assert done.stderr == '', (name, done.stderr)
            result['raw'].append(event)
            (base / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('Diagnostic paired round', round_id + 1, 'of 3 completed', flush=True)
for name in names:
    records = [e for e in result['raw'] if e['workload'] == name]
    profiles = [e['profile'] for e in records if e['variant'] == 'profile']
    phases = list(profiles[0]['phases'])
    assert all(list(p['phases']) == phases for p in profiles)
    result['summary'][name] = {
        'control_median_ms': statistics.median(e['elapsed_ms'] for e in records if e['variant'] == 'control'),
        'instrumented_median_ms': statistics.median(e['elapsed_ms'] for e in records if e['variant'] == 'profile'),
        'phase_medians': {n: {u: statistics.median(p['phases'][n][u] for p in profiles) for u in ['wall_ms', 'cpu_ms', 'entries']} for n in phases}}
verify()
result['status'] = 'passed'
result['finished_utc'] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
(base / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
for name in ['title-search-10k', 'insertion', 'stack', 'dsu']:
    phases = result['summary'][name]['phase_medians']
    print(name, sorted(((n, round(v['cpu_ms'], 2)) for n,v in phases.items()), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:7], flush=True)
